decisions.decision: Do not model Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices as one business node. Split it into three business nodes while preserving the filing's combined revenue line as a separate financial disclosure bucket.
decisions.decision_zh: 业务结构中不把 Subscriptions、Platforms 和 Devices 作为一个整体；拆成三个业务节点，同时在财务披露视图保留 10-K 合并披露的收入桶。
decisions.reason: Business ontology and financial presentation are different structures and must not be forced into one hierarchy.
